name: The Hudson Valley
summary: Presidential estates, a legendary sculpture park, a mountaintop military academy, and the river that named a school of painting.

lodging.name: A Hudson Valley country inn
lodging.blurb: Base near Rhinebeck or Cold Spring, both walkable and full of restaurants.

foodMustTry.name: Dinner at a Culinary Institute of America restaurant
foodMustTry.blurb: America's top culinary school runs student restaurants in Hyde Park.

days.label: Day 88 — Hyde Park
days.summary: FDR's home and the first presidential library.

item.title: FDR Home & Presidential Library

location.name: Home of Franklin D. Roosevelt NHS
location.address: 4097 Albany Post Rd, Hyde Park, NY

item.blurb: Roosevelt's lifelong home and the first presidential library, plus Eleanor's retreat at Val-Kill nearby.

item.title: Vanderbilt Mansion

location.name: Vanderbilt Mansion NHS
location.address: 119 Vanderbilt Park Rd, Hyde Park, NY

item.blurb: A Gilded-Age Beaux-Arts estate above the river.

days.label: Day 89 — Storm King & the river
days.summary: Monumental sculpture and a walk across the Hudson.

item.title: Storm King Art Center
item.blurb: 500 acres of monumental outdoor sculpture set in rolling meadows — Calder, Serra, di Suvero.

item.title: Walkway Over the Hudson
item.blurb: The world's longest elevated pedestrian bridge, on a former railroad span high over the river.

days.label: Day 90 — West Point & Cold Spring
days.summary: The military academy and a riverside antiques village.

item.title: West Point tour
item.blurb: A guided tour of the U.S. Military Academy — the Plain, the chapel, and Hudson overlooks (reserve ahead; ID required).

item.title: Cold Spring village
item.blurb: A postcard river village of antique shops and cafés below Storm King.

days.label: Day 91 — Into the Catskills
days.summary: West across the river into the mountains.

commute.scenicNote: Cross to the west bank and climb into the Catskills.
